character.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand / character reference for kinetic typography.
Create a genuinely polished, art-directed flat pictogram CHARACTER POSE SHEET for a Japanese motion-design explainer about a staff member handing a report to a supervisor. This should look like an expensive contemporary motion-design studio's identity system, NOT generic clip art, NOT a stick man made of pills.

Layout: wide landscape transparent canvas, precise equal 5-column by 2-row grid of TEN isolated full-body pictogram poses. NO text, NO labels, NO lines between cells. Keep each whole body with feet visible, generous empty padding in its own cell. Same physical height and proportions throughout. Two characters: top row the staff member, bottom row the supervisor. They share the same sophisticated silhouette design language.
Columns in BOTH rows: 1 standing relaxed confidently with arms down; 2 presenting/handing a report to the RIGHT with a naturally bent elbow and open hand; 3 holding and reading a report in front of the chest; 4 asking a calm question while indicating a report to the LEFT with a bent arm and open other hand; 5 a small thoughtful puzzled lean with one palm open, composed not comic.
Paper is a small clean off-white rectangular report with 2 dark lines, only for columns 2,3,4.

Art direction: crisp solid navy #23364b, elegant angular shoulder line, expertly balanced geometric head and body proportions, compact head, tailored jacket-like torso using a few clever negative-space collar cuts, long clean trouser silhouettes, shoes integrated as subtle directional wedges, believable elbow bends, visually connected shoulders rather than floating arms, rounded corners only where deliberate. Refined geometric pictogram, completely flat vector-like color shapes. Strong graphic rhythm, assertive but approachable, cut-paper precision, compact professional human silhouette. Faces featureless. The STAFF has an open neck/collar with no tie. The SUPERVISOR has a narrow ochre-orange #e48032 tie, and otherwise exactly the same body proportions, design family, and color. Do not make the boss taller or heavier. Do not use orange anywhere except the supervisor's tie.
No gradients, no 3D, no shadows, no texture, no facial features, no hair, no fingers detail, no cartoon comedy, no floating ball joints, no thick uniform sausage limbs, no extraneous icons, no extra people, no environment. Truly transparent background. This sheet will be used as the single shared reference and sprite source for storyboard stills. All ten poses must be beautifully consistent.
character.encoding: Lossless WebP; RGBA equality with original PNG verified.

videos.prompt: Create one continuous 6-second animation using the supplied first and last frames. The paper stays physically connected to a hand throughout, with no duplicate or disappearing report.
